scored_papers.title: Enforced Gaplessness by Combining Non-Anomalous Symmetries
scored_papers.abstract: Symmetry-enforced gaplessness is a phenomenon in which a quantum system is forced to be gapless due to its global symmetry. Previous works have mainly focused on anomalous symmetries. Another approach, using symmetry spans, which specify two embeddings of a common symmetry into two larger symmetries, was proposed by the authors. In this work, we show that a symmetry span can enforce gaplessness even when both larger symmetries are invertible and non-anomalous: each alone admits a trivially gapped phase, but because the embeddings differ by a twist associated with a symmetry-protected topological phase, the symmetry they generate admits no gapped phase with finitely many ground states. We present such a span of a finite group and $\mathrm{U}(1)^2$ in 1+1 dimensions, with continuum realizations and a lattice Hamiltonian, with a finite-dimensional local Hilbert space and finitely many parameters, that is gapless in any region of its parameter space. We also discuss a 2+1-dimensional example and spans of only finite symmetries.
scored_papers.reason: 🔥 アノマリーが無くても gapless が強制される新機構！🧩 非アノマラスな対称性の組み合わせで gapped 相を禁じる発想は、アノマリー整合の議論を広げます。
scored_papers.summary: 🔬 SPT 分のねじれを持つ対称性スパンを、有限群と U(1)^2 で1+1次元に構成。有限次元局所ヒルベルト空間の格子模型で全パラメータ領域 gapless を示す。

scored_papers.title: An Intrinsically Gapless Topological Phase with Dipole Symmetry
scored_papers.abstract: We show that the boundary fractionalization familiar from gapped topological insulators can enforce bulk gaplessness in a dipole-conserving system. In a one-dimensional fermion model with charge conservation, dipole conservation, and particle-hole symmetry, we realize an intrinsically gapless symmetry-protected topological (igSPT) phase combining a dipolar Luttinger liquid with half-quantized boundary charges. This boundary structure obstructs a unique gapped bulk preserving these symmetries and lattice translation. Remarkably, the two charge-neutral edge configurations remain exactly degenerate even at finite size due to dipole conservation and particle-hole symmetry. The boundary fractionalization also manifests as shifted conformal towers in the dipole-resolved entanglement spectrum, reflecting distinct conformal boundary conditions of the Luttinger liquid. We support our analysis of the igSPT by studying exactly-solvable limits and performing DMRG computations, establishing its stability for a wide range of tuning parameters.
scored_papers.reason: 🌟 境界の電荷分数化がバルクの gapless を強制！🧲 SPT と境界モードの関係を、格子フェルミオン模型で具体的に追える好例です。
scored_papers.summary: 📐 電荷・双極子保存と粒子正孔対称性を持つ1次元模型で、双極子 Luttinger 液体と半整数境界電荷を伴う igSPT 相を実現。厳密可解極限と DMRG で安定性を確認。
